text:
olivia: starting staggered v2 push to eu-west-1 now. canaries green-ish but spotted some payload truncation on long system prompts, tagging @infra-oncall :eyes:
deploy-bot: deploy initiated: v2-eu-west-1-canary -> nodepool-12 (job 67234)
sam: truncation how severe? logs? request ids?
olivia: small sample attached below. truncated response had "...<TRUNCATED>" mid-json for tenant=acme-inc, request_id=rid_9f3b
priya: can you paste the exact request + response snippet? also which model variant (float16 / q4_0)?
olivia: model=v2-small-q4_0, seq length ~5k bytes encoded. snippet:
```
POST /v2/generate
{"input":"<long system prompt>...","max_tokens":512}
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
{"id":"rid_9f3b","choices":[{"text":"...some text...
...partial_json
\"user_meta\":{\"session\":\"abc\"},<TRUNCATED>"}]}
```
infra-oncall: seeing an increase in serialize_errors on that pool, likely encoder->decoder buffer mismatch after quant change. correlating with ~0.8% 5xxs in canary slice over 10m
elena-product: if tenant manifests get truncated we should pause. customer impact potential > low-medium. recommend hold and pin affected tenants to v1 until hotfix
sam: agree. propose immediate hold for this canary and add auto-pin rule for requests with large system prompts (>4000 chars)
release-coordinator: pausing rollout across remaining regions. deploy-bot: stopping rollout per operator request.
deploy-bot: deploy paused by user release-coordinator at 3478124300 (reason: payload truncation in canary)
priya: who owns the investigation? I can take model-side root cause. infra-oncall can repro with a crafted prompt and attach kernel logs?
infra-oncall: will repro on nodepool-12 and collect liveness + libc logs. tagging ticket INF-4921. ETA 90m
olivia: pushed a quick mitigation: added routing rule to send requests with Content-Length > 3800 to v1. not ideal but avoids further customer impact.
elena-product: include a blurb in release notes: "Paused v2 EU rollout due to intermittent response truncation for long system prompts; auto-fallback to v1 for large prompts until fix."
sam: follow-up ops actions:
- INF-4921: repro + kernel/log dump (infra-oncall)
- MODEL-8002: quantization rollback test + tokenization audit (priya)
- REL-345: update release notes + customer comms (elena-product)
assigning owners and setting 24h follow-up
release-coordinator: created REL-345 and CC'd support + account success. drafting brief for affected tenants. schedule a hotfix window tomorrow 03:00 UTC if root cause confirmed
priya: starting a bisect between v2-small-q4_0 vs v2-small-fp16 to confirm quantization link. will report by 3478125200
olivia: thanks all. marking thread resolved for rollout decisions; keeping investigation open. :white_check_mark:
